summary: Executed requested backend release workflow regressions, added targeted RBAC/revision tests, ran frontend production build, and performed UI smoke on public preview URL for label wizard and admin release detail. Core backend workflows passed; two requirement gaps found (draft YouTube URL validation and finance UI action visibility).

critical.issue: Draft creation accepted artist_web_url using YouTube custom handle format (https://youtube.com/@customhandle) with HTTP 200. Requirement says only original /channel/UC format allowed.

ui_bugs.issue: Finance user can see release mutation controls (start_review / need_revision / reject) on admin release detail page, despite RBAC requirement that finance/support cannot mutate release workflow.

action_items: Enforce validate_artist_web_url() in draft create/update path (not only submit) so invalid YouTube @handle/custom URLs are rejected early.
Hide/disable AdminReleaseWorkflow mutation buttons for non-release workflow roles (admin_finance/admin_support) in frontend, while keeping backend guard as final enforcement.
After fixes, retest wizard invalid artist web URL flow and finance admin release detail RBAC visibility on preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend workflow/state transitions for PPR and annual flows are solid in tested paths (including idempotent send_payment and delivered->live identifier guard).
There is a validation consistency gap: Spotify URL validation is enforced during draft save, but artist_web_url format restriction is deferred to submit only.
UI role-based action rendering is missing in AdminReleaseWorkflow; backend blocks unauthorized actions, but frontend still exposes restricted controls to finance role.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 tests passed across required suites + targeted iter55 tests)
success_rate.frontend: 88% (wizard flows, validations, responsive/overflow checks passed; RBAC action-visibility issue found)

seed_data_creation: Temporary DB fixture release iter55-ui-15648 was created for admin/finance UI role check and cleaned up after validation. Temporary API-created draft for URL validation check was also cleaned.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Required regressions passed cleanly. New targeted test file added: test_iter55_release_rbac_revision.py (3 passed). UI evidence captured that finance sees mutation buttons on admin release detail. Admin release list may be empty unless fixtures are seeded.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (artist web URL): release_workflow_service.validate_artist_web_url enforces /channel/UC for YouTube, but create_release_draft/update_release currently do not call it; only submit path validates full metadata, allowing invalid URLs to persist in draft. RCA-2 (finance UI RBAC): AdminReleaseWorkflow renders buttons purely by release.status and does not gate by logged-in admin role, so finance sees mutation actions even though backend /admin/action correctly returns 403 for unauthorized roles.
